routingPrefix.description: Routing prefix of the virtual extension's location.

phoneNumber.description: Directory number of the virtual extension.

firstName.description: First name of the person at the virtual extension.

lastName.description: Last name of the person at the virtual extension.

level.description:
Level of the virtual extension. It can be either `ORGANIZATION` or `LOCATION`.
 * `ORGANIZATION` - Organization level.
 * `LOCATION` - Location level.

locationId.description: ID of the location to which the virtual extension is assigned. The location ID is a unique identifier for the location in Webex Calling.

locationName.description: Name of the location to which the virtual extension is assigned.

displayName.description: Display name of the person at the virtual extension.
